relations_to.summary: Keep New Caledonia in the Republic through the Bougival accord (12 Jul 2025: a 'State of New Caledonia' within the Republic, local nationality); the pro-independence FLNKS rejected it, the referendum was dropped and Macron announced a supplementary agreement (Elysee-Oudinot) in 2026.
